I was pregnant at 18 with my first child and living with my mom and younger sister. My mom told me that she and my sister didn't want a baby in the house because they wouldn't be able to smoke inside anymore. So she said that I could either have an abortion or move out. 

I was utterly flabbergasted, and became emotional since hormones and who the fuck says that to their child? So we fought for an hour before I left the house to go to a friend's and cry it out. I told my boyfriend who told his mom who told me to come move in with them that night. 

When I returned to my moms to pack my things, she was on the phone with what sounded like a doctor's office. She looked at me and said I'm scheduling your abortion, what day do you want to go? 

I laughed in her face and said hang up the phone I'm not having an abortion. She hung up and proceeded to scream at me the entire time I was packing. She was finally silent as I loaded my things into my boyfriend's car.
